profile.summary: ACT Education Corp. provides assessments, research and work-ready credentials for education and the workplace. It runs the ACT college and career readiness test, including a District Testing program that lets K-12 districts give the ACT to students at school. It is a Delaware public benefit corporation based in Iowa City, Iowa.
